response.sql: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT a.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3), region_counts AS (SELECT district_id, region, account_count, AVG(account_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg FROM district_counts), above_average AS (SELECT district_id, region, account_count, account_count - region_avg AS excess FROM region_counts WHERE account_count > region_avg), ratios AS (SELECT district_id, region, account_count, excess, account_count * 1.0 / AVG(account_count) OVER () AS ratio FROM above_average), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ratio DESC) AS ratio_rank FROM ratios) SELECT district_id, region, account_count, excess, ratio FROM ranked WHERE ratio_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ratio DESC, district_id;
